policy.admission_rule: Adopt only when the capability improves an accepted workflow without weakening evidence, rights, security, publication or spend gates.
policy.data_rule: Never send credentials, private object history or unpublished evidence to an external capability unless an explicit adapter contract and applicable authorization permit it.

capabilities.label: Archify
capabilities.purpose: Generate deterministic, inspectable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle documentation from typed JSON.
capabilities.integration: User-level Codex skill plus checked-in typed diagram sources and generated HTML documentation. Network update checks are disabled by the project wrapper.
capabilities.cost: No provider charge for local generation; local compute only.
capabilities.data_boundary: Receives only the bounded architecture specification supplied to the local CLI. No secrets or private datasets.
capabilities.next_gate: Regenerate diagrams when a material architecture decision changes the typed source.

capabilities.label: OpenSEO
capabilities.purpose: Add keyword research, rank tracking, competitor, backlink, site-audit and AI-visibility signals to demand learning.
capabilities.integration: Map normalized outputs into market observations, feedback signals and commercial experiments behind the existing object contracts. Do not duplicate its full UI, auth or database stack.
capabilities.cost: Disabled because self-hosted data requires a paid DataForSEO key and per-request spend.
capabilities.data_boundary: Future adapter may send only a bounded public domain or keyword request; credentials stay in the local secret boundary and raw provider payloads are retained only when licensed.
capabilities.next_gate: Approve a small costed demand experiment only after the public site and measurable buyer question exist.

capabilities.label: MiniMind
capabilities.purpose: Potential local, OpenAI-compatible economical model route for low-risk bounded classification or extraction tasks.
capabilities.integration: Use the existing model-routing boundary if a local MiniMind endpoint later passes task-specific quality, latency, privacy and total-cost evaluation. No model weights or training datasets are installed now.
capabilities.cost: Avoided now: model downloads, local inference latency and training/GPU cost are not justified by current evidence.
capabilities.data_boundary: No project data is sent to or used to train MiniMind. A future local endpoint receives only the minimum task payload allowed by its evaluated route.
capabilities.next_gate: Benchmark one low-risk task against the economical API route and require equal acceptance quality at lower total cost.
